SELECT FROM tb_member m LEFT JOIN tb_site s ON s.site_id = m.site_id WHERE m.member_id = #{memberId} AND m.delete_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_member ( member_id, site_id, login_id, password, password_changed_at, password_expire_at, role_ids, group_ids, member_name, nickname, email, email_hash, email_verified_yn, phone, phone_hash, birth_date, birth_year, gender, di, di_hash, parent_name, parent_di, parent_di_hash, address_zipcode, address, address_detail, join_type, status, login_fail_count, privacy_agree_yn, terms_agree_yn, marketing_agree_yn, sms_agree_yn, email_agree_yn, delete_yn, created_by, created_ip, created_at, updated_by, updated_ip, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{siteId}, #{loginId}, #{password}, #{passwordChangedAt}, #{passwordExpireAt}, #{roleIds}, #{groupIds}, #{memberName}, #{nickname}, #{email}, #{emailHash}, COALESCE(#{emailVerifiedYn},'N'), #{phone}, #{phoneHash}, #{birthDate}, #{birthYear}, #{gender}, #{di}, #{diHash}, #{parentName}, #{parentDi}, #{parentDiHash}, #{addressZipcode}, #{address}, #{addressDetail}, COALESCE(#{joinType},'EMAIL'), COALESCE(#{status},'ACTIVE'), 0, COALESCE(#{privacyAgreeYn},'N'), COALESCE(#{termsAgreeYn},'N'), COALESCE(#{marketingAgreeYn},'N'), COALESCE(#{smsAgreeYn},'N'), COALESCE(#{emailAgreeYn},'N'), 'N', #{createdBy}, #{createdIp}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{updatedBy}, #{updatedIp}, COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_member SET member_name = #{memberName}, nickname = #{nickname}, email = #{email}, email_hash = #{emailHash}, phone = #{phone}, phone_hash = #{phoneHash}, address_zipcode = #{addressZipcode}, address = #{address}, address_detail = #{addressDetail}, marketing_agree_yn = COALESCE(#{marketingAgreeYn}, marketing_agree_yn), sms_agree_yn = COALESCE(#{smsAgreeYn}, sms_agree_yn), email_agree_yn = COALESCE(#{emailAgreeYn}, email_agree_yn), updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_ip = #{updatedIp}, updated_at = COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND delete_yn = 'N'

UPDATE tb_member SET password = #{password}, password_changed_at = #{passwordChangedAt}, password_expire_at = #{passwordExpireAt}, login_fail_count = 0, locked_until = NULL, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_ip = #{updatedIp}, updated_at = COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND delete_yn = 'N'

UPDATE tb_member SET last_login_at = #{lastLoginAt}, last_login_ip = #{lastLoginIp}, login_fail_count = 0, locked_until = NULL, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_ip = #{updatedIp}, updated_at = COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND delete_yn = 'N'

UPDATE tb_member SET login_fail_count = CASE WHEN locked_until IS NOT NULL AND locked_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(login_fail_count, 0) + 1 END, locked_until = CASE WHEN locked_until IS NOT NULL AND locked_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN NULL WHEN COALESCE(login_fail_count, 0) + 1 >= #{threshold} THEN DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL #{lockMinutes} MINUTE) ELSE locked_until END WHERE login_id = #{loginId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(login_fail_count, 0) FROM tb_member WHERE login_id = #{loginId} AND delete_yn = 'N' LIMIT 1
SELECT locked_until FROM tb_member WHERE login_id = #{loginId} AND delete_yn = 'N' LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_member SET login_fail_count = 0, locked_until = NULL, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_ip = #{updatedIp}, updated_at = COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT captcha_required_yn FROM tb_member WHERE login_id = #{loginId} AND delete_yn = 'N' LIMIT 1

UPDATE tb_member SET delete_yn = 'Y', status = 'SUSPENDED', updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_ip = #{updatedIp}, updated_at = COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
